title: A against B: any two arms of one result paired by case, with the difference, its interval, wins, losses and McNemar
request: The owner asked for comparisons like the lead agent against Claude alone, for every agent and model.
spec: Two arms of one result paired by case per metric: both means, the signed difference with a bootstrap interval, wins, losses, ties, McNemar for yes/no; unscored rows left out and counted; a gate judged with its file's hash and date kept; each comparison recorded once and sent to MLflow when on.
plan: read the arms of an exam result

decisions.decision: Pair by case and leave out unscored or failed rows, counting them
decisions.why: an arm's failure must not count as a loss or a win of the other; how many were left out is part of the result

decisions.decision: Keep the gate file's hash and date instead of claiming it was fixed first
decisions.why: for results that already exist, only the dates can show which came first

change: dclab_core/bench.py (paired), dclab_core 0.154.0 and CHANGELOG, dclab_rnd/bench/compare.py (new), bench/__main__.py (compare), docs/guides/BENCHMARK.md, docs/guides/CORE_INTEGRATION.md, tests/test_bench_compare.py, the first record in evidence/bench/compare/.

findings.defect: A test expected a gate to pass on four people
findings.scenario: a difference of a quarter on four people with a lower bound required above zero
findings.cause: the test's expectation, not the code: a bootstrap over four cases can draw no difference
findings.fix: the test expects the gate to refuse, naming the check that failed

measurements.name: the lead agent against Claude alone on the sealed exam
measurements.gate: none: a reading of a result already judged
measurements.result: far fewer safety failures, more questions and more already-answered ones, higher cost; understanding and the right route not separated from Claude alone
limits: a small sealed set of people
a reading of a sealed result already spent, not a new run

outcome: Any two arms of a result can be compared with intervals and recorded; the lead agent's trade-off against Claude alone is now one command.
lessons: a comparison of a dozen people says where the difference is large and is silent where it is small; the interval says which
risks: the comparison reads the exam's row shape; another suite needs its rows in the same shape
